selection: minimum best_val_loss; ties use candidate order
search_method: predeclared one-factor search, no adaptive expansion
budget: 11 fresh runs x at most 200 epochs; one fixed seed; no test access

week10_ablation.factor: GCN depth 2/3/4; validation and mean pairwise cosine of hidden embeddings
GAT heads 1/4/8, fixed total hidden width
LP dot-product/MLP decoder, fixed saved split

error_analysis: validation only; degree bins 0-2, 3-5, 6+ excluding self-loops; report counts, errors and confusion matrix; test analysis uses saved predictions only
